answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 35081 Country: India Title: Is there any ruling regarding shaving of hairs of private or underarms for men Question: Is there any ruling regarding shaving of hairs of private or underarms for men? Please remember us in dua. Answer ID: 35081 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1762/1421/B=1432) It is sunnah to shave it every week. However you can delay it, but delaying it to more than forty days is makrooh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
